messages.subject: Common metric completely standardized solution in multi-group analysis
parts:
Dear all,

I was wondering if there is a way of getting from lavaan a common metric completely standardized solution in multi-group CFA analysis, such as the one in LISREL.

 

Thank you for any suggestion.

 

Damiano

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Common metric completely standardized solution in multi-group analysis
parts: I was wondering if there is a way of getting from lavaan a common metric completely standardized solution in multi-group CFA analysis, such as the one in LISREL.

I wasn't aware of that option in LISREL. You mean that parameters are expressed in units of pooled (across groups) SD?  I can see the advantage of that in some cases, but lavaan only provides within-group standardization.  I would suggest requesting this feature by posting a new issue on GitHub:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
